excerpt: Anthropic announced on September 18 that Accenture will be an embedded evaluation partner, with the work led by Accenture's Faculty business. Anthropic says it will fund Accenture's work directly. It also says access and reporting standards remain unsettled and that no settled funding system exists; the work is beginning, so the announcement is not a completed independent assessment.
